Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Luck Bar

Gambler (Jackpot) is able to gain luck with every attack. From Upgrades 0-5, he will gain +5% luck per hit (with 1 hit). From Upgrades 6-8, he will gain +3.3% luck per hit (with 3 hits). Luck gained per hit has a chance to be tripled, scaling off his Crit Rate (50% chance to triple with 50% Crit Rate, 100% chance to triple with 100% Crit Rate). Upon reaching 100% luck, Gambler (Jackpot)'s ability will activate Frenzy.

Frenzy

Once activating Gambler (Jackpot)'s ability with 100% luck, he will activate a frenzy for all units within his range (including himself). Frenzy will increase Crit Rate for Units in range by +50% (this does not work on True damage type units such as Umbra (Nuclear)) for 30 seconds with about a 32 seconds cooldown (No Global Cooldown).

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • This is the first support unit to buff crit chance
  • This is currently the only known way for magic damage units to critically hit.
  • Although it is possible to maintain perfect uptime with Gambler at upgrade 0 and 3, it is very unreliable. Upgrade 6 is necessary for consistent uptime with Frenzy.
  1. ↑ Takedowns refer to kills or assists
